rationale.conceptual: The method involves a custom physical model (2D free energy functional, lock-in and elastic terms), a specific ansatz (Jacobi amplitude), and numerical optimization of multiple parameters. The solver must correctly translate the paper’s equations into code, handle periodic boundaries and discretization, and interpret the physical results. It goes beyond standard library use and requires understanding the underlying theory.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of implementing the free energy, looping over five temperatures, running a Nelder–Mead optimizer, and saving one JSON output. It uses only standard Python libraries (NumPy, SciPy) and has no external tooling, data fetching, or complex orchestration. Essentially a single script with linear steps.
